description: Week-by-week NASS crop condition ratings for corn, soybeans, or wheat across the growing season — each week's excellent/good/fair/poor/very poor shares plus a combined good+excellent percentage — from USDA NASS QuickStats. Use to track crop health trends, compare weeks within a season, or compare the same weeks across seasons; use get_crop_condition instead when only the latest week matters. Read-only lookup of stored statistics; no API key. Default: up to `weeks` most recent stored weeks, oldest first (default 12, max 52). Pass start_period and/or end_period (YYYY or YYYY-Www, e.g. 2024 or 2024-W30) instead to get every stored week inside that inclusive period range, with the range actually returned in the result. Each entry carries period (YYYY-Www), a condition object with the excellent, good, fair, poor and very_poor percentage shares, and good_excellent (good + excellent combined). Stored weekly history covers the 2021 season onward (backfilled from QuickStats), national plus major corn-belt states, and a new season is appended each year.

end_period.description: Optional last period to return (YYYY or YYYY-Www); a bare year means through that year's season.

geography.description: US for national, or state code (IA, IL, etc.); state coverage is the major corn-belt states. Default: US

start_period.description: Optional first period to return (YYYY or YYYY-Www). With start_period/end_period, returns all stored weeks in range instead of the most recent `weeks`.

weeks.description: Number of most recent weeks to return (default 12, max 52). Ignored when start_period/end_period are given.

name: get_crop_condition_history
